description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the Akka Replicator, including methods to retrieve the name, role, and complete configuration, as well as an enum for default config values.

classes.name: AkkaReplicatorConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration methods for the Akka Replicator in a distributed system.

classes.name: AkkaReplicatorConfig.AkkaReplicatorConfigValue
classes.description: An enum listing known configuration paths and default values for the Akka Replicator.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the replicator.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the cluster role for members with replicas.

methods.name: getCompleteConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the complete Akka distributed-data configuration.
